participantsParagraph: Participants will have the opportunity to attend seminars held by national and international experts, visit state-of-the-art research laboratories, and discover the wonderful city of Bologna.
aprilParagraph: From April 19 to 23, Bologna will become the heart of Italian physics. Lectures, workshops, social events, and much more.
